source.subject: chemistry
source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned 1-page paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page image. Header prints '2nd INTERIM TEST, 2022 -2023', 'CLASS 7', 'CHEMISTRY', 'TIME : 40 MIN.', 'MARKS 20.' and the note 'write down the given sequence number only don't make your own sequences'; examYear 2023 is the later year of the printed academic year. No school name printed. Section A (all compulsory): Ques 1 (2, four blanks at ½ each, kept together), Ques 2 (3, six compounds at ½ each, kept together), Ques 3 (5, split into five 1-mark definitions). Section B 'Attempt any two questions' of Ques 4-6 (5 marks each, parts with printed marks); a pick-2-of-3 choice, not an OR pair, so choiceGroup is not used and all three are included; the pack total (25) therefore exceeds the maximum (20) by design. Chemical subscripts are printed as subscripts on the paper and are written flat here. Paper's own wording ('law conservation of mass', 'The gas have', 'FeCl2.') kept as printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
